output.title: Change only affects upstream ACME E2E tests, not deployed components
output.content: The release notes list this under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". It says only that cert-manager's own ACME E2E tests now use Pebble v2.7.0 and were changed to match Pebble's latest behavior. Nothing in the excerpt mentions a change to deployed images, chart values, CRDs or runtime behavior. The environment summary shows a Deployment (apps/v1), Certificate resources (cert-manager.io/v1), the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD and four values keys, and none of these is tied to the project's test setup.
